en: Is that you, Susan?
It's me, Grandpa.
Glad to see you.
And am I glad to see you.
I am also glad to be here.
How are things?
I have been talking to a group of salesmen since 10 this morning,
and I'm real exhausted.
cn: 我就一直在和一群推销员开会，累坏了。

en: You look good.
What's Harry doing tonight?
He and Michelle are visiting relatives in New Jersey today.
cn: 今天去新泽西看望亲戚了。

en: The rest of our family went to the movies.
cn: 家里其他人去看电影了。

en: So it's just you and me, Susan.
It's nice to be alone with you, Grandpa.
cn: 能和你单独待在一起真好，爷爷。

en: We don't get to see enough of each other.
cn: 我们见面的机会太少了。

en: No, I feel the same way, Susan.
I miss seeing you.
To tell the truth, next time I'd like to go into the city
and meet you there instead of you coming here.
You don't need to do that, Grandpa.
Yeah, I do.
I need to get out more.
Well, I mean, there's a lot to do around the house,
and I love being here with the family, you know,
cn: 我也喜欢和家人在一起，

en: but I'm restless.
Since I retired, I've got extra time on my hands.
I understand, Grandpa.
I think you do.
Frankly, I'd like to use my brain a little more.
Grandpa, you have so much energy
cn: 您精力充沛，又有多年经验。

en: and so many years of experience.
There are probably a lot of places for you to work,
cn: 可能有很多地方都需要您，

en: particularly in the construction field.
But at my age, I'm not looking for a full-time job.
I'm retired, but I'm bored.
Well, there must be something.
Maybe I can help.
Let's go into the kitchen,
and maybe you can help me set the table.
Ha! Sounds good to me. What are we having?
I prepared lamb chops, mashed potatoes,
and a tossed green salad to begin with.
cn: 土豆泥，还有开胃的蔬菜沙拉。

en: Grandpa, you are a terrific guy.
You're still thinking about something to do, aren't you?
cn: 您还在想找点事做，对吧？

en: A job of some kind.
That's right.
I've been thinking about it for weeks now.
There must be some way to put my mind to good use.
cn: 总该有办法让我这脑子派上用场。

en: We'll find a solution,
a positive solution to your finding a way
to use that wonderful mind of yours.
Sam, would you come in, please?
You sound like something's bothering you, Susan.
cn: 你听起来像有什么烦心事，Susan。

en: The sketches for the cover of the new doll book?
cn: 是新洋娃娃书封面的草图吗？

en: That's not it. Please sit down.
Sure.
I need your advice on a personal matter,
but it's not about me.
You need my advice on a personal matter,
cn: 你需要我给关于私人事务的建议，

en: and it's not about you, okay?
It's about my grandfather.
What's the problem?
It won't sound like a big deal, but it is.
cn: 听起来可能不算什么大事，

en: I had dinner with him Saturday,
and he's very unhappy about not working.
cn: 他因为没工作很不开心。

en: I thought he was retired and pleased
to be living with the family.
cn: 也很乐意和家人住在一起。

en: He is.
But there's so much energy and talent in the man,
cn: 但他精力充沛、才华横溢，

en: and he doesn't get to use it.
Well, what can I do?
What kind of advice are you looking for?
Simply this.
John Marchetta runs this company.
cn: John Marchetta 经营这家公司。

en: He founded this company.
Right.
John Marchetta gave me my start here.
cn: 六年前 John Marchetta 给了我来这里的机会，

en: Six years ago, when I first graduated from college,
he gave me the chance to use my talents
and made me feel more confident.
Right.
Maybe he can do the same thing for your grandfather.
cn: 也许他也能为你爷爷做同样的事。

en: Or at least give him some advice.
Right.
Then I've solved your problem.
I can always depend on you, Sam.
I'm glad to help.
Shall I call Mr. Marchetta for you?
cn: 要我替你给 Marchetta 先生打电话吗？

en: No, no, I'll do that.
Thanks.
No, how's the Stewart family?
Fine, thank you, Mr. Marchetta.
Except for my grandfather.
What's wrong, Susan?
What's wrong with him?
He needs to work.
In fact, that is the reason why I am here to see you.
cn: 事实上，这就是我来见您的原因。

en: I know you're building a new factory,
and I thought maybe my grandfather
is so experienced in the construction trade,
cn: 我爷爷在建筑行业很有经验，

en: he could be so valuable.
Tell him to come and see me at 10 o'clock tomorrow morning.
I have an idea that may solve the problem for him,
help a lot of other people.
Really, Mr. Marchetta, can I tell him that?
Sure can.
10 o'clock in the morning.
Here.
Oh, ah.
Malcolm Stewart.
John Marchetta.
Sit down, sit down.
Susan has told me a great deal about you.
cn: Susan 跟我讲了很多关于您的事。

en: She says you're quite a man.
She says a lot of wonderful things about you too,
cn: 您很多了不起的事，Stewart 先生。

en: Mr. Stewart.
That's always nice to hear, Mr. Marchetta.
cn: 这话听着总是让人高兴，Marchetta 先生。

en: Call me John.
May I call you Malcolm?
Let's talk business.
That's music to my ears.
I understand you used to be in the construction business.
cn: 您以前是做建筑行业的。

en: Yep, 43 years.
Here's a brief description of 43 years of on-the-job training.
cn: 四十三年工作经验的简介。

en: Some history.
You're a valuable asset, Malcolm.
Very valuable.
Thank you.
43 years.
Half that time in my own construction company.
cn: 一半时间在经营自己的建筑公司。

en: Big jobs, factories, shopping malls, that kind of thing.
Then you retired.
Yes.
After my wife died,
and I felt I should spend more time with my children and grandchildren.
cn: 我觉得应该多花点时间

en: I lived in Florida, and they lived in New York.
I understand.
My daughter, Cami,
cn: 我女儿 Cami 住在纽约。

en: lives in New York. I like being near her.
When I came here, I planned to take a few months off,
relax with the family,
cn: 陪陪家人，然后找点事做。

en: and then look for some work.
cn: 和然后寻找为了一些工作.

en: Put my experience on the line.
But, unfortunately, there isn't any work for a retired person my age.
cn: 我这个年纪的退休老人没适合的工作。

en: Sometimes there is, and sometimes there isn't.
I'm involved with an organization,
and we're trying to resolve that problem.
cn: 我们正试图解决这个问题。

en: What's that?
Tops.
T-O-P-S.
It means talented, older people's society.
cn: T-O-P-S——意思是杰出老年人才协会。

en: I'd like to be a member.
How much are the Jews?
There are no Jews.
The organization serves major companies in this city.
cn: 这个组织为这座城市的大公司服务。

en: Why?
Because our members are men and women like you.
cn: 因为我们的会员都是像您这样的人。

en: Experienced, talented, retired.
cn: 经验丰富、才华横溢、已退休。

en: But our members want to go out there and use their talents.
They want to work.
That is fantastic, John.
I've got an idea for you, Malcolm.
Just fill out this form for me.
It'll only take a few minutes.
Sit right here and do it while I talk to my secretary.
cn: 我跟我秘书谈事的时候你填。

en: When I get back, we'll talk about my new factory.
cn: 等我回来，我们谈谈我的新工厂。

en: My company's a member of Tops,
cn: 我的公司是 TOPS 的会员。

en: so I try hard to find opportunities for people like you, Malcolm.
cn: 所以我努力为像您这样的人找机会。

en: And when I see an opportunity, I can act on it.
Well, I can use your brain power on the job right now.
cn: 嗯，我现在就能用您的智慧。

en: Have you got time this morning to go over to the construction site with me?
I'd like to have you meet my foreman.
cn: 我想让您见见我的工头——

en: Get some background on the job.
I've got plenty of time.
I'll be right back.
We'll go over to the job site together.
Have you worked on the space port project?
cn: Malcolm，您参与过 Spaceport 项目？

en: My company was a contractor.
I built the theater there with my own two hands, practically.
I understand.
Well, I'm glad to see you two guys getting along so well.
cn: 很高兴看到你们俩相处得这么好，

en: Because, Danny, Malcolm is on the Tops team.
cn: Malcolm 是 TOPS 团队的。

en: He's going to be working with you for a while.
cn: 他会和你一起工作一段时间。

en: His experience will be valuable to both of us.
cn: 他的经验对我们俩都很有价值。

en: Welcome aboard, Malcolm.
I'm going back to my office.
Give me a call later, Malcolm.
I'll tell you the time and date of the next Tops meeting.
cn: 我会告诉你下次 TOPS 会议的时间和日期。

en: I'd like you to meet the group.
cn: 我想让你见见这个团体。

en: I will, John.
And again, thanks.
No.
Thank you.
And thanks, Susan.
He's quite a man.
A real inspiration for me.
Okay, Danny.
I know you didn't expect to have me around,
but I think I can be of some help to you.
Let me tell you something, Malcolm.
With your background and experience, I can learn something.
And I do need some advice and a difficult problem.
cn: ……我确实需要一个难题的建议。

en: Let me show you this.
I don't want to give you a final opinion
without studying these building plans more carefully.
cn: 需要更仔细地研究这些建筑图纸。

en: But a simple solution might be to move the air conditioning units
instead of redesigning the entire system.
cn: 而不是重新设计整个系统。

en: It might be simpler and less expensive.
You just earned your weight in gold, Malcolm.
Welcome aboard.
It'll all happen so quickly.
I can't believe it.
I'm glad Mr. Marchetto was so helpful.
cn: 很高兴 Marchetta 先生这么帮忙。

en: He was more than helpful.
He actually took me to meet his foreman.
cn: 他还带我去见他的工头。

en: I'm thrilled for you, Grandma.
I don't know how to thank you, Susan.
You're a wonderful granddaughter.
It's good to see you so happy.
I'll be at the construction site tomorrow.
What are you doing tomorrow night?
I'm not doing anything. Why?
How about a date with your grandfather?
I owe you a good steak dinner.
cn: 我欠你一顿上好的牛排。

en: I'll accept tomorrow night, you and me, dinner.
What time?
I'll pick you up here at seven.
Is that okay?
I can't wait.
And you can tell me all about your first full day
cn: 你重新上班第一天的全部情况。

en: back on the job.
It's a deal.
